turns.speaker: user
turns.text: A bit tired today, but okay.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: My group of friends wants to do something on Saturday night and they've put me in charge, help.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Let me get through all the options before you weigh in.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: There's an escape room in town that fits six people, about an hour, and then we could grab food after.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Someone suggested karaoke, private booth, but half of us can't sing and one person hates it.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Or a pub quiz at the local, cheap and easy, though it gets super crowded and loud.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: That's all I've got. Which would you choose?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: The escape room sounds like the winner, it's something everyone can join, and food afterwards gives you time to chat. Karaoke is risky if someone really hates it, and the pub quiz is better on a quieter night.
